title: Services Overview
meta_description: Consulting and delivery across eight deep-tech towers, run as one delivery system with shared platforms and named gates.

blocks.x: Consulting and delivery across eight deep-tech towers, run as one delivery system with shared platforms and named gates.

Dataq Software's services are organized into eight towers. Each tower carries named services with defined deliverables and the platform rails they deploy on. Towers compose: a fraud program draws on data engineering, agentic automation and cybersecurity at the same time, under one delivery plan and one accountable lead.

items: Strategy, model selection, retrieval, evaluation and the operations that keep models accurate in production. We start from the business metric, not the model.
Goal-directed agents that run inside your systems with defined roles, budgets and human checkpoints. Every action is logged, measurable and reversible.
Pipelines, lakehouse and governance built so reports reconcile, lineage is traceable end to end, and access is controlled without slowing teams down.
Identity-first architecture covering workforce, customer and machine access, with detection, response and AI-specific controls in one program.
Hybrid and edge estates engineered for reliability, cost per workload and clean day-two operations, with an internal platform your teams actually adopt.
Optimization, simulation and post-quantum cryptography migration, applied where the mathematics pays back and benchmarked against classical baselines.
Permissioned networks, tokenization and verifiable credentials with the reporting and controls supervisors expect.
Sensor integration, digital twins and robotics that let operations teams see, simulate and act on physical assets in one loop.

blocks.x: Every service is delivered through the Dataq Method — Diagnose, Design, Prove, Industrialize, Compound — with gates that finance and risk actually sign. Services arrive on platform rails where relevant, so production hardening (security, replay, monitoring, documentation) is inherited rather than rebuilt.

Every deliverable arrives with its control mapping: model cards, decision replay, DORA-grade third-party evidence, EU AI Act technical documentation — generated during delivery, never reconstructed for audit.
Explore a tower, or book a Value Assessment to sequence the portfolio against your P&L.
